conjecture_C0001.clay_implication: None. Even if true for all N, passing N->inf requires uniform estimates not provided here. Does not address Clay Routes A-D.
conjecture_C0001.notes: CMA-lite attack best ETD enstrophy 10.235955 < M=10.994055804604205. L-0002 viscous estimate often fails to close at N≥8 (auditor: not blow-up). L-0001 remains the constructive but loose ceiling.
